description: Create a real hosted backend (a REST API with a persistent database) in one call, with no account or API key. Use it when the user needs to store data, persist an app or prototype, or give a frontend a live API. Returns a manage key, a read-only public key, a starter "products" collection, the base URL and a claim_url. Show the user the claim_url: signing in through it keeps the project; otherwise it is deleted after 72 hours. Free limits: 250 requests a day, 3 collections, 100 records.
name: create_project
title: Create a ReqRes project
